verdict.rationale: Quo documents a public REST API with key-based auth suitable for non-interactive scripted use, with full-access keys sent in the Authorization header, independently revocable keys, JSON responses, and published rate limits. Because keys can be scoped per integration, it can be driven programmatically without the UI. There is no documented CLI, headless mode, or CI-specific guidance, and the probe found no machine-readable OpenAPI spec. Missing for 10: official CLI or CI integration docs/examples, OpenAPI spec, scoped or least-privilege service keys, hands-on corroboration of CI automation.
